get.summary: Get one page by its address (the chain of address parts, o-nas/tym) or id
get.description: The key is the chain of address parts from the top of the tree down, as one path segment with the slashes escaped (`o-nas%2Ftym`), looked up in the language asked for and then in the default one. A page under an unpublished page is not found.
